data.name: Placeholder_ComingSoon
data.value: The dashboard will be available in a later version.

data.name: Admin_LocalOnly
data.value: This page is only available on the hotspot PC (http://localhost:8080) until staff login exists.

data.name: Network_Intro
data.value: Choose the internet connection (WAN) and the adapter connected to the customers' Wi-Fi access point (LAN), then click "Share the internet".

data.name: Network_Problem_NotAdministrator
data.value: The service is not running with administrator rights. Run it as the Windows service or from a "Run as administrator" prompt.

data.name: Network_Problem_NotWindows
data.value: Connection sharing only works on Windows.

data.name: Network_Problem_NoLanAdapter
data.value: No second network adapter for the customer network. Plug in the adapter connected to the access point, or turn on Windows Mobile hotspot.

data.name: Network_Problem_AdapterNotFound
data.value: The chosen adapter no longer exists (unplugged or uninstalled).

data.name: Network_Problem_SameAdapter
data.value: The internet connection and the customer network must be two different adapters.

data.name: Network_Problem_WanNoGateway
data.value: The internet connection has no gateway: it does not seem to reach the internet.

data.name: Network_Problem_LanDown
data.value: The customer network adapter is disconnected (cable unplugged or access point off).

data.name: Network_Problem_IcsSubnetConflict
data.value: IP address conflict: the internet connection already uses 192.168.137.x, which Windows reserves for sharing. Change your router or modem's network.

data.name: Network_Problem_MobileHotspotOff
data.value: Windows Mobile hotspot is off. Turn it on in Settings > Network & internet > Mobile hotspot.

data.name: Network_Problem_IcsFailed
data.value: Windows refused to change connection sharing.

data.name: Network_Problem_IcsNotActive
data.value: The configured sharing is not active in Windows. Click "Share the internet" to turn it back on.

data.name: Network_Problem_GatewayIpConflict
data.value: IP address conflict: another device uses the gateway address. The access point is probably in router mode: switch it to access point / bridge mode.

data.name: Network_Problem_DevicesOutsideSubnet
data.value: Some devices have addresses outside the hotspot network. The access point may hand out its own addresses: turn off its DHCP / router mode.

data.name: Devices_Intro
data.value: Devices recently seen on the customer network (refreshes every 5 seconds).

data.name: Devices_None
data.value: No device detected yet. A device shows up as soon as it has exchanged data with the PC.

data.name: Devices_NotConfigured
data.value: First choose the customer network adapter under "Network".

data.name: Devices_RandomMacNote
data.value: Recent phones use a different "private / random" MAC address for each Wi-Fi network. That is normal: it stays the same on this network. To whitelist a device, always use the MAC shown here.

data.name: Portal_Connected
data.value: You are connected: the internet is available.

data.name: Portal_Continue
data.value: Continue to the page you asked for

data.name: Blocked_Text
data.value: Access to {0} is blocked on this Wi-Fi network.

data.name: Gate_Intro
data.value: Test page: authorise or revoke a device by hand, and watch the counters.

data.name: Gate_Redirected
data.value: Web connections redirected to the portal

data.name: Gate_AuthorizeNote
data.value: "Authorise" whitelists the device (permanent free access). "Revoke" removes it from the whitelist and ends its session. The effect shows within 1–2 seconds.

data.name: Gate_RulesNote
data.value: Changes apply within about 10 seconds. A domain includes its subdomains (facebook.com also blocks m.facebook.com).

data.name: Gate_Error_InvalidRule
data.value: This is neither a valid domain name nor an IP address.

data.name: Gate_NoDevices
data.value: No device detected. First set up the network under "Network".

data.name: Network_Problem_GateFailed
data.value: The packet filter (WinDivert) could not start: connection sharing stays off so the Wi-Fi is not left open.

data.name: Network_Problem_GateNotRunning
data.value: The packet filter is not running yet.

data.name: Portal_CodeLabel
data.value: Enter the code from your ticket

data.name: Portal_BuyCode
data.value: No code? Buy a ticket at the counter.

data.name: Terms_Default
data.value:
Wi-Fi access is reserved for customers with a valid code or account.
You agree to use the internet lawfully: no illegal activity, no downloading of protected works without permission, no harm to other users or to the network.
The time and data of your code are counted as explained at the counter. A code can only be used on the number of devices it allows.
For network security and to comply with the law, your device's address (MAC), its IP address and connection times are recorded.
The business may cut off access in case of abuse. The service is provided without any guarantee of speed or availability.

data.name: Portal_Unavailable_Text
data.value: The Wi-Fi is unavailable for the moment. Please ask at the counter.

data.name: Portal_DeviceUnknown
data.value: Your device could not be identified. Disconnect from the Wi-Fi, reconnect, and try again.

data.name: Login_InvalidCode
data.value: Invalid code. Check the characters and try again.

data.name: Login_VoucherDisabled
data.value: This code has been disabled. Please ask at the counter.

data.name: Login_QuotaUsed
data.value: The time or data of this code is used up.

data.name: Login_TooManyDevices
data.value: This code is already in use on the maximum number of devices. Log out another device first.

data.name: Login_LockedOut
data.value: Too many attempts. Try again in {0} minute(s).

data.name: Login_DeviceBlocked
data.value: This device is not allowed on this network.

data.name: Login_AccountDisabled
data.value: This account is disabled. Please ask at the counter.

data.name: Login_InsufficientBalance
data.value: Not enough balance. Top up your account at the counter.

data.name: Status_PauseNote
data.value: The time stops counting when you log out.

data.name: Status_WallClockNote
data.value: The time keeps running even if you log out.

data.name: Status_Redirecting
data.value: Taking you to the page you asked for…

data.name: Ended_QuotaUsed
data.value: Your time or data is used up. Buy a new code to continue.

data.name: Ended_Expired
data.value: Your code has expired. Buy a new code to continue.

data.name: Ended_Idle
data.value: You were logged out after a period without activity. Log in again with the same code.

data.name: Ended_KickedByStaff
data.value: Your connection was stopped by staff.

data.name: Gate_TestVouchersNote
data.value: To try the portal before the dashboard (phase 5): create a code, write it on paper, then type it on the phone.
